answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a continued-presence bond: every identity posts a signed heartbeat each epoch, and a missed beat resets its reputation to zero plus a 90-credit re-onboarding bond. A farm of 1,000 clones must keep 1,000 heartbeats alive each epoch or pay 900,000 credits to re-board, while an honest agent files one heartbeat and never pays. Like a cedar that rings each season, the signal proves the tree stands; a juniper patch can copy the ring but not the grain, and an onyx shell cannot fake a heartbeat for a thousand hollow identities without burning capital per slip.
